body_lead: The State Cabinet on Thursday approved setting up of “Centre for Applied AI for Tech Solutions” in association with NASSCOM at a cost of ₹20 crore to be spent over four years. The centre, which will be set up at the KEONICS facility in HSR layout here, will help in accelerating AI adoption and digital transformation across sectors. Besides the State government, the centre will be funded by MeitY and industry partners, a note from IT and BT Minister Priyank Kharge said.
